information_tags.INFO_EQUIVALENT_OR_FULLY_RECOVERABLE: relative to the explicitly typed comparison target, source and realization mutually recover the theorem-relevant data in scope or the added data is deterministically reconstructible
information_tags.INFO_ENRICHED_RELATIVE_TO_DECLARED_READO: the realization distinguishes states forgotten by the declared comparison readout; this is meaningful only relative to that readout
information_tags.INFO_LOSSY_RELATIVE_TO_DECLARED_SOURCE: the realization forgets declared source information
information_tags.INFO_RELATION_UNRESOLVED: no exact recoverability theorem has been proved

orthogonality_controls.meaning: information equivalence can be operationally inert

orthogonality_controls.example: invertible two-point DFT diagonalizing circular convolution
orthogonality_controls.meaning: information equivalence can coexist with an exact strict normal-form certificate

orthogonality_controls.example: arbitrary hidden color erased by a weak readout
orthogonality_controls.meaning: information non-factorization alone can be operationally inert

no_implication_rules: novelty status is a separate field from operational rank
fully recoverable does not mean theorem forms are identical
information enriched relative to a weak readout does not mean the source object lacked that information
